source: The three-dimensional representation (3, or its conjugate 3') of the rotation group of the icosahedral carrier, with the charged basis fixed by a face third-turn (the generation register of model/lepton_register_round) and the neutral basis fixed by a second residual subgroup of the same group. A kinematic construction: it contains no dynamics that produces the residual subgroups. It is not one of the common-dynamics candidates of openwave-tuning/common_dynamics/SOURCE_CONTRACT.md and no frozen producer is consumed.
hypothesis_under_test: If the neutral states are fixed by a subgroup of the carrier's rotation group acting on the same triplet, the mixing matrix is the overlap of two eigenbases and holds no free number.
outcome: The hypothesis gives 7 patterns (79 angle triples) for a third-turn charged basis; none within 3 standard deviations on all three angles; nothing in the repository selects one. Clause 3 is not met.
